The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the [[List of animated series specials|animated series specials]] in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Dedicated releases== ===Pikachu's Winter Vacation series=== {{incomplete|section|needs=Confirm titles of Pikachu shorts on VHS releases}} The [[Pikachu's Winter Vacation]] series of [[Pikachu short]]s were released on home video in the United States on both VHS and DVD. The Pikachu's Winter Vacation VHS was released in the United States in 1999. It contains two Pikachu shorts, ''[[PK02|Christmas Night]]'' and ''[[PK03|Kanga Games]]''. The Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2 VHS was released in the United States in 2000. It contains two Pikachu shorts, ''[[PK05|Winter Games]]'' and ''[[PK06|Stantler's Little Helpers]]''. The Pikachu's Winter Vacation DVD was released in the United States on November 23, 2004 by {{wp|Echo Bridge Home Entertainment|Platinum Disc}}. It contains four Pikachu shorts: ''[[PK02|Winter Vacation]]'', ''[[PK03|Winter Games]]'', ''[[PK05|Winter Vacation 2]]'', and ''[[PK06|Stantler's Little Helpers]]''. These are the same shorts as the VHS releases, but under different names (with some names belonging to different shorts). The DVD does not include English closed captioning. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Pika}} |border={{colorschemedark|Pika}} |image1=Pikachu Winter Vacation VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=Pikachu's Winter Vacation VHS |image2=Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2 US VHS.png |size2=x200px |caption2=Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2 VHS |image3=Pikachu's Winter Vacation DVD.jpg |size3=x200px |caption3=Pikachu's Winter Vacation DVD }} ===''Mewtwo Returns''=== {{incomplete|section|needs=Catalogue number}} ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'' was released by {{wp|Warner Bros.}} on home video in the United States on both VHS and DVD. It was released on VHS in the United States on December 4, 2001. It was released on DVD in the United States on December 4, 2001 with the catalogue number 22412. The DVD includes English, French and Spanish audio, with optional English, French and Spanish closed captioning. The DVD includes the following extras: * ''[[The Uncut Story of Mewtwo's Origin]]'' * "[[Born to Be a Winner]]" * Trailers of the first three Pokémon movies {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Johto}} |border={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |image1=Mewtwo Returns US VHS.png |size1=x200px |caption1=VHS cover |image2=Mewtwo Returns DVD US.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD cover }} ===''Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!''=== {{incomplete|section|needs=Bundle details}} ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]'' was released on DVD in the United States on September 18, 2006 as part of a limited edition bundle with [[Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Blue Rescue Team]] or [[Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team]] at Walmart stores. The disc came in a DVD pocket rather than a DVD case. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Hoso}} |border={{colorschemedark|Hoso}} |image1=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon- Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate! DVD.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD pocket front |image2=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon - Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate! US DVD back.jpg |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD pocket back |image3=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon - Red Rescue Team DVD bundle front.jpg |size3=x200px |caption3=Red DVD bundle front |image4=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon - Red Rescue Team DVD bundle back.jpg |size4=x200px |caption4=Red DVD bundle back |image5=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon - Blue Rescue Team DVD bundle front.jpg |size5=x200px |caption5=Blue DVD bundle front }} ===''Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness''=== ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness]]'' was released on DVD in North America on August 17, 2008 as part of a limited edition Pokémon pack that included the DVD, a {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} Onyx [[Pokémon-themed console editions|special edition]] [[Nintendo DS Lite]], a carrying case, and a mini-poster of {{p|Grovyle}}. The disc came in a clamshell DVD pocket rather than a DVD case. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Hoso}} |border={{colorschemedark|Hoso}} |image1=Explorers of Time and Darkness DVD.png |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD pocket front |image2=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon- Explorers of Time & Darkness US DVD back.png |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD pocket back |image3=Explorers of Time and Darkness DVD Interior.jpg |size3=x200px |caption3=DVD pocket interior }} ===''Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time & Darkness''=== ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky - Beyond Time & Darkness]]'' was released on DVD in the United States on October 12, 2009 as a [[pre-order bonus]] for customers that pre-ordered [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky]] at [[GameStop]]. The disc came in a DVD pocket rather than a DVD case. {{MerchGallery |background={{colorschemelight|Hoso}} |border={{colorschemedark|Hoso}} |image1=PMD EOS disc front.jpg |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD pocket front |image2=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of the Sky disc back.jpg |size2=x200px |caption2=DVD pocket back }} ===Pokémon: The Arceus Chronicles=== ''[[Pokémon: The Arceus Chronicles]]'' was released on DVD in the United States on February 27, 2024 by VIZ Media with distribution through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. The catalogue number is 3000097300. {{MerchGallery |background={{hisui color light}} |border={{hisui color dark}} |image1=Arceus Chronicles DVD.jpg |size1=x200px |caption1=DVD cover }} ==As bonus content== ===Pikachu shorts=== [[Pikachu short]]s are occasionally included in the same release as [[List of English language Pokémon movie home video releases (Region 1)|Pokémon movies]] on VHS and DVD. ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]'' | style="background:#FFF; {{roundybr|5px}}" | April 7, 2009 |} ===''The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon''=== {{main|List of English language Pokémon movie home video releases (Region 1)#Lucario and the Mystery of Mew|List of English language Pokémon movie home video releases (Region 1) → Lucario and the Mystery of Mew}} The second English dub of ''[[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon]]'' was included on a bonus disc in the Collector's Edition ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]'' DVD. It was released in the United States on September 19, 2006 by {{wp|VIZ Media}}. This release uses a 4:3 {{wp|Aspect ratio (image)|aspect ratio}}.
